Hiring guidance

What to look for.

01

Concrete and steel

Confirm experience in the structural system your project uses: in-situ, precast or steel.

02

Detailing knowledge

For rebar and steel roles, ask which codes and schedule formats they have worked to.

03

Analysis links

If your design team uses analysis models, check experience exchanging data with them.
